title: Pictiva Displays and Samsung settle their two OLED patent disputes
content: In 2025, Pictiva Displays sued Samsung Electronics in the Texas Federal Court, saying that the Korean company infringes two of its US patents (US8,314,547 and US11,828,425), relating to OLED displays. Later in the year, the court found Samsung Electronics to be guilty, and ordered it to pay $191.4 million in damages.

title: Phison posts record September revenue as AI tops half of sales
content: Phison Electronics reported record September consolidated revenue of NT$30.639 billion (US$959 million), up 8% from August and 370% from a year earlier. The Taiwanese storage chipmaker said AI-related applications accounted for more than 50% of total revenue, underscoring how demand is expanding across storage, computing, networking and AI infrastructure.

title: Zhen Ding posts record September sales on mobile demand and AI applications
content: Zhen Ding Technology said September 2026 consolidated revenue reached NT$26.358 billion (US$825.13 million), up 36.13% year over year and 27.54% from August, setting a monthly record. The PCB maker said the result reflected strong orders from mobile communications products as well as continued growth in its server, optical module and IC substrate businesses.
